data.text:
🚨 BREAKING: MASSIVE 8.8 MAGNITUDE QUAKE NEAR RUSSIA TRIGGERS TSUNAMI EMERGENCY ACROSS PACIFIC

🔥 WHAT HAPPENED
A huge magnitude 8.8 earthquake struck off Russia’s Kamchatka Peninsula in the early hours of July 30, 2025, triggering tsunami warnings across the North Pacific—impacting Hawaii, Japan, Alaska, California, and more.

🌊 HAWAII UNDER THREAT
First wave arrived around 7:17 p.m. HST, reaching Kauai and Honolulu with sea levels rising nearly 3 ft above normal.

Governor Josh Green declared a state of emergency, urging residents to evacuate beaches, move inland or to higher floors of buildings—ideally the 4th floor or above.

Sirens and cell-phone alerts sounded island-wide; traffic jams and canceled flights complicated evacuation efforts.

First tsunami measurements from Midway Atoll showed waves of about 6 ft peak-to-trough—effectively a powerful 3 ft wave on top of regular surf.

Rescue teams and emergency shelters have been activated, with potential power and water service interruptions.

🌏 HITS ACROSS THE PACIFIC
Japan evacuated over 900,000 people across multiple regions; waves of 30–50 cm already hit Hokkaido, with larger waves expected.

Severo‑Kurilsk, Russia reported 3-meter waves, flooding, and damage to buildings.

U.S. West Coast, including Northern California to Alaska, remains under tsunami watch or warning. Crescent City, CA is bracing for 2–5 ft surges tonight.

Nations including Philippines, Mexico, New Zealand, Chile, and Ecuador have all issued alerts for tsunami risks and dangerous coastal currents.

💥 DAMAGE & AFTERSHOCK POTENTIAL
Reports confirm injuries and structural damage near the epicenter in Russia.

USGS issued a rare red alert for potential widespread destruction—this is one of the strongest earthquakes recorded in decades.

Officials warn that multiple waves are likely, and the first is rarely the largest.

Aftershocks measuring between 6.3 and 6.9 continue, raising fears of further instability.

🔔 HOW TO SHARE AND STAY SAFE
⚠️ VIRAL POST:
 “Massive 8.8 quake off Russia has triggered tsunami warnings across the Pacific—Hawaii hit first with 3 ft waves; evacuation and emergency orders in effect! Widespread alerts from Japan to California—multiple waves expected. Share to raise awareness and save lives!”
✅ SAFETY TIPS:

If you're in a coastal area of Hawaii, Alaska, or the U.S. West Coast, follow all local evacuation orders.
Stay away from beaches, harbors, and marinas—dangerous conditions can last for hours.

Do not assume the threat is over after the first wave—later waves may be stronger.

Move to higher ground or upper floors of reinforced buildings.

📷 BREAKING: Massive Tsunami Hits Pacific After 8.8 Earthquake Off Russia 📷A catastrophic magnitude 8.8 earthquake struck off the eastern coast of Russia’s Kamchatka Peninsula, triggering widespread tsunami warnings and evacuations across the Pacific Ocean.  📷 LIVE TSUNAMI IMPACTS REPORTED: • Hawaii: First tsunami waves have struck Oahu — with 4ft (1.2m) waves confirmed and multiple surges expected. • Governor Josh Green urges calm but warns the public: “Do not return until it’s declared safe.” • Honolulu mayor tells residents in low-lying areas: “Head to higher ground immediately.” • No toilet flushing or running water in many coastal areas of Maui to prevent system damage.  📷 JAPAN IN CRISIS MODE: • 1.9 million people ordered to evacuate along the eastern coast. • A 4.3ft (1.3m) wave has already struck Iwate Prefecture. • Roads gridlocked, trains shut down, and Fukushima nuclear plant workers evacuated as a precaution.  📷 RUSSIA DECLARES EMERGENCY: • Severo-Kurilsk flooded after at least three tsunami waves surge through the town. • Sakhalin region officially under a state of emergency. • Residents evacuated to safety zones just an hour after the quake. • Power grids damaged, blackouts reported.  📷 PACIFIC WIDE ALERTS ISSUED: • Evacuation orders or warnings now active in:  United States West Coast (California, Alaska)  Japan  China  Philippines  Indonesia  New Zealand  Guam  Peru  Galápagos Islands (Ecuador)  📷 What Experts Say: • Tsunami waves travel at jet plane speed, meaning every coastal zone in the Pacific could be hit within hours. • Japan’s Meteorological Agency warns: “Tsunamis can continue for over 24 hours—do not let your guard down.”  📷 STAY SAFE:  Move inland or to elevated areas  Avoid all beaches and harbors  Monitor local emergency broadcasts and alerts  Bring supplies if evacuating—traffic jams and blackouts are widespread  This is one of the strongest quakes in modern history—and the situation is still unfolding.
